result.intro: your san antonio people actually got you — gabe + lena on where to walk, shoot, and not get tourist-trapped. all free / cheap.

items.title: pearl at dusk
items.what: ground fountains lit pink/blue/purple reflecting on wet pavement, trees in string lights, old brewery chimney behind. just post up at the edge and watch. grab tacos only if you cave.
items.whyYou: you saved this reel and you're into film + night light — portra energy, and gabe calls it his saturday ritual so he'll go with you.
items.priceHint: free to walk, $12 tacos if you cave

evidence.caption: pearl at dusk. the ground fountains lit up, trees wrapped in string lights, a kid and a dog losing their minds in the spray, the old brewery chimney behind it all. saturday ritual. free to walk, $12 tacos if you cave #sanantonio #thepearl
evidence.sawLive: ground fountains are lit pink, blue, and purple and reflecting on the wet pavement, with trees wrapped in warm string lights and the tall brick pearl chimney behind them. crowd's just chilling around the edges — a kid running by the spray, a dog with its people, someone taking a photo — really chill dusk vibe.

items.title: river walk, 20 mins max
items.what: stone bridge, trees lit purple + green, boat with red lights down the water. walk it at dusk for photos then bounce to pearl/southtown to eat — don't eat down here per lena + gabe.
items.whyYou: for your photographer brain — purple/green reflections are made for that slow 6:40pm film thing you love.

evidence.caption: took my out of town cousin to the river walk against my will. dusk is the only acceptable time: stone bridge, trees lit purple and green, a boat with red lights way down the water. still not a fan but I get it for 20 minutes. go eat at the pearl after, don't eat down here

items.title: mission san josé
items.what: long weathered stone wall with two rows of arches, green bushes in front. national park, quiet, super photogenic. go slow, it's 300 years old.
items.whyYou: free + historic texture for your art/people eye, and fits your budget run — plus abuela lore if gabe brings you.

evidence.caption: mission san josé with abuela on a cloudy sunday. the long wall of stone arches, two rows, green bushes in front, weathered like it's been there 300 years because it has. free. national park. she lit a candle and then made me drive her to h-e-b. spare room in southtown is open, she WILL cook for you
evidence.sawLive: yeah it's mission san josé, just a long weathered stone wall with two rows of arches and green bushes in front under a cloudy sky. it's outdoors and historic so great for photos, and per the caption it's free to visit.
